summary: Invoice email daily limit returns 429 instead of 500 from 2027-01-14
details:
From 2027-01-14, POST Invoices/{InvoiceID}/Email returns 429 Too Many Requests instead of a generic 500 when the organisation reaches its daily invoice-email limit. The 429 has no Retry-After header. Code that treats 500 as a retryable server error, or retries a 429 at once with a short backoff, will mishandle the limit.

Handle a 429 from the invoice Email endpoint separately from the per-minute rate limit. It is a daily limit with no Retry-After header, so don't retry immediately. Queue the send for after the daily reset, or tell the user sending was delayed. Stop relying on a 500 to detect this case.
